directions: Reuse step4 immutable all-receiver direction register, coupled across magnitude/kappa/policy; no new direction selection.
eligible: All receivers in immutable official32_minus71 map with at least 10 valid RSSI receptions among the exact original 16612 calibration rows. No evaluation-count or error filter.
historical_information: Previous numerical results and full core already known; new receiver selection and scores not inspected at lock.
identity_warning: Six stratified diagnostic targets, not a random sample of networks and not evidence that participation alone causes the outcome.
order: descending calibration count, ascending numeric receiver ID for ties
participation: Count raw valid receptions under finite [-150,-20] dBm rule among original calibration rows; not evaluation participation or weight mass.
scientific_scope: D3 as planned: catalogue map only; single target; D=1000,5000m; 32 directions; kappa=1,4.7; frozen, unrestricted, shared_update, bounded10, bounded30; D=0 once per target.
selection: Within each stratum of length m>=2 use zero-based indices floor((m-1)/3) and floor(2*(m-1)/3). If equal, use indices 0 and m-1. Retain empty/undersized strata without outcome-selected replacement.
strata: numpy.array_split ordered eligible list into 3 contiguous nearly equal sized groups: upper,middle,lower; earlier groups receive any extra entries
